fields.description: The cart this document bills. Set only when the booking was made in a multi-booking checkout — every row of that cart shares THIS one document. `booking` names the row it was created for and is never re-pointed; the print shows the group.
fields.label: Booking Group

fields.description: Open Play participant row this document bills.
fields.label: Participant Ref

fields.description: Empty on a walk-in document — customer_name carries the receipt identity.
fields.label: Customer

fields.description: Derived from the booking: Paid & Verified on confirmation, Cancelled when the booking is cancelled or expires. Never edited directly.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The platform's per-booking fee the customer pays on top (Per Booking tenants only). Printed as its own line; never discounted; OUTSIDE the VAT footer — the fee is the platform's non-VAT revenue, and the tenant's VAT is on the court share only.
fields.label: Booking Fee (Platform)

fields.description: The booking fees waived on this document's continuations, printed as 'Less: Continuous booking discount' under a fee line showing what the bookings would have carried. Never inside the total — platform_fee already excludes it.
fields.label: Continuous Booking Discount

fields.description: What the customer pays: subtotal − discount + booking fee.
fields.label: Total Amount

fields.description: How much of the total was settled with store credit rather than money. A PAYMENT, not a discount — the total and the VAT footer are untouched, and the collections report nets this out of what was collected.
fields.label: Paid by Credit

fields.description: Snapshot of the company's VAT registration at creation — a later company VAT change never rewrites history.
fields.label: VAT Mode

fields.description: VAT-INCLUSIVE math over the COURT SHARE: (total − booking fee) ÷ (1 + VAT%). Empty for NON-VAT.
fields.label: VATable Sales

fields.description: The channel the payment came through, copied from the booking / participant on every sync — the reconciliation key (CBT Collections by Channel, CBT Tenant Ledger).
fields.label: Payment Channel

fields.description: The manual O.R./invoice number issued from the company's own BIR-registered pad (staff cross-reference; not synced anywhere).
fields.label: Official O.R. No.

fields.description: When this document went Cancelled (stamped by the billing engine; cleared by a retro-confirm). A PAID document cancelled later keeps its verification stamps AND gains this one — the Tenant Ledger posts the reversal on this date.
fields.label: Cancelled At

fields.description: Why a PAID document was cancelled — typed by the Company Admin who refunded it, stamped by the billing engine on the cancelling save. Read on the Tenant Ledger's reversal line and the printed statement.
fields.label: Refund Reason

fields.description: Whose cancellation this was. A facility-fault cancellation returns cash whatever the company's Refund Policy says, so the record has to say which it was.
fields.label: Refund Cause

fields.description: The money left as STORE CREDIT, not cash. Without this a money report cannot tell the two apart, and a Reschedule only company would appear to pay out cash it never paid.
fields.label: Refunded As Store Credit

fields.description: Snapshot of the company's billing document title (EOPT-safe default: BILLING STATEMENT).
fields.label: Document Title
